asc_606_revenue_recognition.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers (5-Step Model)
steps: 1. Identify the contract with a customer
2. Identify the performance obligations in the contract
4. Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations
5. Recognize revenue when (or as) the entity satisfies a performance obligation
asc_606_revenue_recognition.application: Automated contract parsing and milestone-based revenue schedule generation.

irs_pub_15_payroll_tax.title: Employer's Tax Guide - Federal Withholding & FICA

components.social_security: 6.2% employee + 6.2% employer up to wage base limit
components.medicare: 1.45% employee + 1.45% employer (+ 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax for wages > $200k)
components.futa: 6.0% on first $7,000 of employee wages (subject to state tax credits up to 5.4%)

irs_pub_15_payroll_tax.application: Automated payroll reconciliation, quarterly Form 941 verification, and W-2/W-3 tie-outs.

double_entry_bookkeeping_rules.application: General ledger automated journal entry validation and trial balance equality enforcement.

steps: 1. Compare company Cash General Ledger ending balance with Bank Statement ending balance.
2. Add deposits in transit to bank balance.
3. Subtract outstanding checks from bank balance.
4. Add interest earned and electronic collections to book balance.
5. Subtract bank service fees, NSF checks, and EFT payments from book balance.
6. Ensure Adjusted Book Balance == Adjusted Bank Balance ($0.00 variance).
bank_reconciliation_framework.application: Automated bank feed reconciliation for bookkeeping clients and anomaly detection.
